status.description: Which of the three states is CURRENT after this write. `never` is unreachable here (every write stamps one of the two timestamps) and is listed because the vocabulary is the same one the screen reads.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.
